description: ADR 0228 (B-077, ADR 0158 Open 4): the coupled combination lifted 0.5 m above its equilibrium pose and released at standstill. Before ADR 0228 it bounced back to ~85 % of the drop height (elastic bump stops, undamped tyres). Checks the share of the drop energy returned as the first rebound and the time spent airborne again.

checks.source: the drop is a flight: sqrt(2 * 0.4 / 9.81) = 0.29 s (wheels hang below the static pose)
E = KE + PE does not grow in free flight
damped landing: <= 45 % of the drop energy comes back as the first rebound (ADR 0228 criterion; before ADR 0228: 0.68 laden40 / 0.37 empty, measured after: 0.38 / 0.16)
the combination does not take off again after the landing
chassis does not dig into the road (ADR 0165 bumper-crush bound)
coupling holds through the landing (free_fall_drop_comb bound)
